layout_and_spacing.card_style: border border-[#1F2937]/10 bg-white p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#1F2937]/5

hero.layout: Grid-based or text-centered heavy typography layout. Use max-w-4xl for the headline to maintain reading length.
hero.cta_button: bg-[#10B981] text-white px-8 py-4 text-lg font-medium hover:bg-[#059669] transition-colors

dynamic_form.customization: Use sharp corners or subtle rounding (rounded-sm). Inputs should have border-[#1F2937]/20, focus:border-[#10B981] focus:ring-[#10B981].
dynamic_form.webhook: Mock the webhook post with a setTimeout promise.

animations.scroll: Use Lenis for momentum smooth scrolling.
animations.reveals: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fade-in-up animations. Stagger children for grids.

image_urls.description: Minimalist modern office. Use as subtle background texture in the problems section or alongside the form.
Business people in meeting. Can be used contextually near the 'Problemas Comunes' section.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='cta-hero-button', data-testid='segment-card-ecommerce').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react (or lucide-react), react-hook-form, zod, @hookform/resolvers/zod.
Create the Hero section with massive typography. Emphasize 'Pues te mintieron' to create a disruptive impact.
The Segmentation section must update a state that feeds into the Dynamic Form section.
The Dynamic Form should conditionally render fields based on the selected segment (e.g., if 'E-commerce', ask for platform like Shopify/WooCommerce; if 'Servicios Locales', ask for City/Region).
On form submit, mock a webhook call, then show a success state with a personalized WhatsApp button ('Hablar por WhatsApp').
